files.rates.md:
# Brindleway Logistics - northern lane parcel tariff

Effective 1 October 2025. One charge per parcel, set from the zone
recorded on the consignment note.

| Zone | Area | Charge per parcel (GBP) |
|---|---|---|
| A | City core | 14.80 |
| B | Outer ring | 21.35 |
| C | Highland | 33.90 |
| D | Islands | 48.25 |

Every booking on this lane carries exactly one parcel.
